# Test fixtures

## `ironwood_v6.pczt`

A real, proven, not-yet-signed v6 (NU6.3 "Ironwood") testnet PCZT, copied
verbatim from ZF's frost-tools repository
(`zcash-sign/tests/fixtures/ironwood_v6.pczt`, commit `06c0dbd`,
https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/frost-tools). It became testnet transaction
`a5533fe75575b09d8986a05005d2c0528cf45a1a7e4cc71b304ae76a9e14487d`, whose
Orchard spend was authorized by a 2-of-3 rerandomized FROST signature; its v6
shielded sighash is
`7d48149e6ae74a301bc74c7e1a5af48c52c0d20550a086899db07555e73f53a5`.

SHA-256: `2b8a861aba7fe7cc55f6989000de8665dd8162bfea41b036c86d8d070abd5bcf`
